representations.aggregation: GPU float32 mean EDF per segment; Python float64 mean segment logits; float64 mean segment embeddings cast float32

normalization: per patient all observable good canonical channels; population variance plus1e-5; no label or cross-patient fit
initialization: all beta,U,b zero; dedicated CPU generator seed42 V std0.01; C2/C3 tensors identical
inner_split: source-stratified SHA256(seed42,outerfold,source) shuffle then round-robin three partitions; same for every arm

training.patient_order: seed42 deterministic epoch permutations of sorted FIT identities, identical across arms

epoch_selection: complete inner head-OOF mean patient AUROC, AP, earlier epoch; fixed outer CNN is in-sample for inner heads

threshold.selection: patient MacroF1, pathologicalF1, balancedaccuracy, closest0.5, smaller
threshold.C0: own outer FIT CNN probabilities, same grid

gate.meaningful_direction: C2 vs direction-off mean patient AUROC >=0.001 and nonzero mean pair reversal

terminal_priority: C2-C1 AUROC<.005 with C1-C0>=.010 and AP/F1/MRR/Top1 nondecline and4positivefolds=>SHARED_PATIENT_RELATIVE_ONLY_SUPPORTED
C2-C1 AUROC<.005 or direction intervention fails=>SOURCE_DIRECTION_NOT_NEEDED
unknown_source: shared beta only, zero source direction and bias
bias_off_ranking: same frozen full ordering after exact float64 constant-translation audit; classification reuses fixed C2 threshold
all_off_threshold: C2 numeric threshold for intervention; C0 own FIT threshold remains separate
